## About

David Iquaibom uses 0xdaruby as his public online identity. He builds software, explores AI tools, and shares practical projects, experiments, and learnings.

- Homepage: https://oxdaruby.tech/

## Projects

- **CallScribe**: A telegram bot that records and transcribes telegram calls remotely, generating summaries using AI API.
  - Technologies: Python
  - Source: https://github.com/0xDaruby/CallScribe.git
- **Email_Automation**: Auto-draft Gmail replies using AI; fully free, runs locally, zero SaaS dependencies.
  - Technologies: Python, Gmail API, SQLite
  - Source: https://github.com/0xDaruby/Email_Automation.git
- **Priv-Con**: A local first document conversion app that processes Office documents, PDFs, and images entirely on the user's machine to guarantee privacy and confidentiality.
  - Technologies: Python, Next.js, React, LibreOffice
  - Source: https://github.com/0xDaruby/Priv-Con.git
- **Hotel Ops Software**: A software solution that aims to bridge the gap in communication between the hotel operations team and the management team.
  - Technologies: TypeScript, PostgreSQL, JavaScript
  - Source: https://github.com/0xDaruby/Hotel-Operations-Software.git
- **Seat Booking Software**: An application used for booking event seat with Paystack integration.
  - Technologies: TypeScript
  - Source: https://github.com/0xDaruby/seat-booking-system.git
- **Portfolio Website series**: A set of portfolio websites built for personal brands and businesses.
  - Technologies: HTML, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript
  - GitHub: https://github.com/0xDaruby/
